items.title: What’s next for issuers after Fiserv cuts a debit network
items.summary: Fiserv CEO Taki Georgakopoulos said at Citi’s Fintech Conference that the technology company was consolidating its debit networks with the intent to sell or wind down the other. It’s a move that could have lasting implications on the debit card issuers and meaningfully shake up debit card routing dynamics.

items.title: Visa And Mastercard Stocks Face A Stablecoin Test Investors Should Watch
items.summary: Stablecoins are moving from crypto corners into boardrooms as banks, SoFi, Visa, Mastercard and major processors race to wire digital dollars directly into everyday payments. That shift could reshape how money flows, where fees land and which listed payment stocks gain or lose influence. This article walks through three stocks from our Digital Payments & Card Networks screener that appear well aligned with this new onchain settlement era.
